description: Slack's official hosted MCP server (Streamable HTTP, user token): messages, channels, threads, files, canvases, lists, reactions and people.
job: Search, read and send messages in your Slack workspace
example_prompts: Summarize what I missed in #general today
Find the thread where we discussed the launch date
Draft a message to #design about tomorrow's review

tools.name: slack_search_public
tools.description: Searches for messages, files in public Slack channels ONLY.

tools.name: slack_search_public_and_private
tools.description: Searches for messages, files in ALL Slack channels, including public channels, private channels, DMs, and group DMs.

tools.name: slack_search_channels
tools.description: Search for Slack channels by name or description.

tools.name: slack_search_users
tools.description: Search for Slack users by name, email, or profile attributes (department, role, title).

tools.name: slack_search_emojis
tools.description: Returns the custom emoji available in the workspace, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: slack_read_channel
tools.description: Reads messages from a Slack channel in reverse chronological order (newest first).

tools.name: slack_read_thread
tools.description: Reads messages from a specific Slack thread (parent message + all replies).

tools.name: slack_read_canvas
tools.description: Retrieves the markdown content and section ID mapping of a Slack Canvas document.

tools.name: slack_read_user_profile
tools.description: Retrieves detailed profile information for a Slack user: contact info, status, timezone, organization, and role.

tools.name: slack_read_file
tools.description: Retrieves the metadata and content of a file shared in Slack (text is returned inline, images rendered; files over 10 MB are rejected).

tools.name: slack_list_channel_members
tools.description: Returns the members of a Slack channel or conversation.

tools.name: slack_list_user_channels
tools.description: Lists the channels the authenticated user is a member of, filterable by type, name prefix and workspace; archived channels are included by default.

tools.name: slack_get_reactions
tools.description: Retrieves the emoji reactions on a Slack message: emoji name, count and the users who reacted.

tools.name: slack_send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to a Slack channel or user. Message uses standard markdown.

tools.name: slack_send_message_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft message in a Slack channel. Only one attached draft is allowed per channel.

tools.name: slack_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedules a message for future delivery to a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Adds an emoji reaction to a Slack message on behalf of the authenticated user.

tools.name: slack_create_conversation
tools.description: Creates a new Slack channel, group DM, or IM conversation on behalf of the authenticated user.

tools.name: slack_create_canvas
tools.description: Creates a Slack Canvas document from Markdown content.

tools.name: slack_update_canvas
tools.description: Updates an existing Slack Canvas, replacing the whole canvas or a single section by section ID.

tools.name: slack_get_file_upload_url
tools.description: Step 1 of a file upload: returns a signed upload URL and file ID; POST the file bytes to the URL, then call slack_complete_file_upload.

tools.name: slack_complete_file_upload
tools.description: Step 2 of a file upload: finalizes the file by ID, optionally sharing it to a channel with a message.

tools.name: slack_create_list
tools.description: Creates a Slack list with a custom schema of typed columns (text, date, select, user and more).

tools.name: slack_read_list
tools.description: Reads a Slack list: its columns and records (rows).

tools.name: slack_update_list
tools.description: Updates a Slack list's metadata and columns.

tools.name: slack_add_list_record
tools.description: Adds a record (row) to a Slack list; columns are addressed by display name or internal key.

tools.name: slack_update_list_record
tools.description: Updates a record (row) in a Slack list; columns are addressed by display name or internal key.

tools.name: slack_delete_list_record
tools.description: Deletes a record (row) from a Slack list.
